options.name: The ordinary Office
options.desc: The Hours as the house has always kept them.

options.name: Common prayer
options.desc: Everyone sings the Hours together. The house is steadier for it.

options.name: Silent hours
options.desc: Long silences after Compline. A devout life is more likely to be noticed.

options.name: The ordinary work
options.desc: What the house has always done.

options.name: Work of the hands
options.desc: Every brother works the fields in the growing season.

options.name: Scholars' hours
options.desc: Half the day at the books, fewer hands in the fields.

options.name: Ordinary hospitality
options.desc: Strangers are fed when the house can spare it.

options.name: Open gate
options.desc: Strangers are taken in as Christ. It costs bread and brings novices.

options.name: Closed gate
options.desc: The gate is kept shut. Less bread goes out, and fewer come asking.

options.name: Ordinary learning
options.desc: Reading and copying as the seasons allow.

options.name: Infirmary first
options.desc: The sick are the house's first duty.
